gameDescriptionHtml:
This is an Exit 8-like work in which only old men appear!
There are many different old men in the station.
Unimaginable mutations await you. Find all of them!
You must use TPS, FPS, and scanning to find the anomalies in an ingenious way.
If you find an anomaly, go to red.
If there is no anomaly, go to blue.
Can you reach platform 7?

This game can be played and distributed live!
We hope that many people will get to know it and enjoy playing it.
